vectors.name: minimal
vectors.note: FAST-sized proven vector (RCA01-PLA-SCOPE-1 checklist item 5): the in-guest fdlibm transcendental cost is ~150k cycles per MC draw, so MC path counts are sized so MAX user_cycles across ALL vectors stays <30M (measured 27.4M at this pp).

vectors.name: convergence-diagnostic-labeling
vectors.note: RCA01-PLA-SCOPE-1 discriminator: at nScenarios=10 the 97.5% ES is a single observation (esCount=1) and the diagnostic still reports GREEN by construction -- it is a Monte-Carlo convergence self-check, and the payload must SAY so (mc_convergence_* fields, MC_CONVERGENCE_* flag, MC Convergence verdict) and must NOT carry the retired PLA/eligibility attestation labels (pla_test_status, pla_ratio, PLA_TEST_*, 'IMA Pre-Validation Passed'). Also FAST-sized (measured 26.1M cycles at this pp).
